description: Holds discount scenario details records, linked to discount scenario header.
business_purpose: Used to track and report discount scenario details records, including amounts and quantities, for the Sales & CRM area.
record_granularity: One row represents one discount scenario detail.

columns.name: id
columns.description: Unique identifier of the discount scenario detail.

columns.name: structure
columns.description: Structure of the discount scenario detail.

columns.name: total_percentage
columns.description: Total percentage of the discount scenario detail.

columns.name: descount_scenario_header_id
columns.description: Descount scenario header id of the discount scenario detail.

columns.name: DiscountScenarioHeaderid
columns.description: Reference to the discount scenario header linked to this discount scenario detail.

columns.name: product
columns.description: Product of the discount scenario detail.

relationships.description: Each discount scenario detail references one discount scenario header (discount scenario header).

business_rules: Use total_percentage for monetary or quantity totals.
Join to Discount Scenario Header through the foreign key columns to resolve names.
common_queries: Discount Scenario Details by discount scenario header
Top discount scenario header by total percentage

known_issues: total_percentage is stored as floating point, so sums can carry small rounding differences.
total_percentage is nullable; use COALESCE when summing or comparing.

query_notes: The database is MySQL/MariaDB; use MySQL syntax and the exact name DiscountScenarioDetails (identifiers can be case-sensitive).
Use COUNT(DISTINCT id) when counting discount scenario detail records; joins can duplicate rows.
Use SUM(total_percentage) for totals of total percentage.
To resolve names, join on: DiscountScenarioHeaderid = DiscountScenarioHeader.id.
